turns.reply:
`python3 roster.py inactive` now lists learners whose last portal login was 14 or more days ago. Run against today's data (2026-10-03) it gives:

```
L-002  Ben Whitlock         ben.w@example.org        ALG1
L-004  Dara Novak           dara@example.org         CHEM2,HIST1
```

I checked the boundary: a login exactly 14 days ago counts as inactive, 13 days does not. The existing `list` and `course` commands are unchanged.

- **Output format:** it is the same as `list` (id, name, email, courses), so the last-login date itself isn't shown. Say if you want it added as a column for the nudge emails.
- **Threshold:** the 14 days is a single constant, `INACTIVE_AFTER`, near the top of `roster.py`; there is no command-line option to change it.

I also added the new command to the usage text in `roster.py` and to the README.
